text:
到了阶的神会在神坛上刷出特殊操作按钮，升阶当场多出来。各神都有「祈求赐福」：把包里能被赐福的最值钱那件换成这位神的赐福版。再往上各神不同：蛮神献祭生命上限换经验值或这局的造成伤害与急速，日神祈祷攒局内永久的火焰加成，大地之神锻炼加棋盘行数。

做了一次特殊操作，这个休息点的神坛就关了，献祭也不能再做；想两样都要就得找下一个休息点。有的操作要先挑一项，比如蛮神献祭生命上限要选换什么。特殊操作改的数跟着这一局走，不进下一局。

texts.en:
Once a god reaches the right Rank, special rite buttons appear on its Altar; ranking up adds them on the spot. Every god offers Pray for a Blessing: turn the most valuable item in your bags that can be blessed into this god's blessed version. Beyond that, each god differs: the Brute lets you offer max Health for XP, or for damage dealt and Haste for this run; the Sun God lets you pray to build up a Fire bonus that lasts for the rest of the run; the God of the Earth lets you train to add rows to your board.

Once you perform a special rite, this rest spot's Altar closes and you can no longer make an Offering either; if you want both, you have to find the next rest spot. Some rites ask you to pick an option first, such as choosing what the Brute's offering of max Health is traded for. Whatever a special rite changes lasts for this run only and does not carry into the next.
